_contract: Top Gun runtime-driver registry v1 — consumed by the top-gun plugin's capability-task-matcher (references/runtime-drivers.md). Each driver is probed and classified per session; cloud drivers without credentials are BLOCKED, never available.
product: FamiliOS — web PWA (Vite/React, root) + native iOS (Expo SDK 56, apps/mobile, bundle ai.familios.app)

drivers.notes: webServer boots `npm run dev` (backend :8787 + Vite :5173; requires Node >=22.13 for node:sqlite) unless one is already running. web-webkit-iphone (WebKit + iPhone profile) approximates iOS Safari/PWA behavior — it is web evidence, never native-iOS evidence. PWA/service-worker specs need a production build surface: set TOPGUN_PWA_BASEURL.

artifacts: cloud session URL, video, device + network logs (vendor dashboard)
drivers.notes: WebDriverAgent is vendor-managed; nothing iOS-native runs on this PC. App artifact: `eas build -p ios --profile preview` in apps/mobile, then upload via tests/topgun/appium/upload-browserstack.mjs. Preview/production builds bake EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://homeops-ai.onrender.com — that backend is LIVE family data, so the default lane is non-mutating; mutation specs require TOPGUN_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=1 and a disposable backend/tenant.

drivers.probe: APPETIZE_API_TOKEN and APPETIZE_PUBLIC_KEY present in env
artifacts: Appetize session logs + shareable session link
drivers.notes: Requires a SIMULATOR build (not .ipa): `eas build -p ios --profile simulator` in apps/mobile (profile added for this harness), upload via tests/topgun/appetize/upload-appetize.mjs. Simulator evidence cannot prove push, camera, biometrics, or real-device performance — escalate those to appium-device-cloud.

routing.pwa (manifest/service-worker/offline/ins: playwright-web (TOPGUN_PWA_BASEURL surface); real-device Safari via device cloud only when standalone-mode truth is required
